281493459.description:
Vintage Mineral Oil Rain Lamp
Fluorescent Motion Tower - Molded Plastic & Wire Construction
Circa 1990s, Multicolor Swirl Finish
This vintage 1990s motion lamp showcases the playful, high-energy aesthetic of late-twentieth-century novelty lighting design. Featuring a swirled multicolor casing in vibrant neon tones, the cylindrical tower houses an internal spiral track accented with colorful beads and fluorescent vertical columns. Strung monofilament rain lines surround the kinetic centerpiece, producing a striking visual display that reacts vividly under ambient and ultraviolet blacklight illumination.
Cylindrical molded plastic base and upper canopy with vivid neon airbrushed swirl finish
Central wire spiral column with multicolored bead accents and fluorescent vertical tubes
Outer monofilament nylon drip lines with top beaded finial ornament
Measures approximately 17 inches tall by 6 inches wide with integrated polarized cord and wheel switch
Condition:
Good vintage condition overall with noticeable cosmetic wear and surface residue from prior use and age. Needs extensive cleaning throughout the strings, reservoir, and housing. Plastic casing and wire structure remain intact. The lamp has been tested and works.

281500327.description: This lot includes two raw apophyllite mineral specimens. The left specimen measures 3x2.5x1 inches and the right specimen measures 2.5x1.5x1.25 inches. Both crystals have a colorless to milky white appearance with transparent to translucent qualities and well-defined hexagonal faces. The larger cluster is roughly oval-shaped while the smaller one is more irregular. Natural matrix is present on the underside, with one piece showing greenish mineralization. The combined weight of both specimens is 232.8 grams. These specimens are in raw, unpolished condition. Due to the softer nature and raw edges of apophyllite, flaking or cracks on the edges may be present. No obvious damage is noted. Suitable for collectors, display, or metaphysical use.
